cache hit rate >= 20% with prefix/KV caching

cost_workshop_notes: Batching: adaptive batching with 15–30ms window for low-latency flows; bigger windows for background reranking jobs
Caching: prefix + user-session KV caching for repeat intents; TTL 12h suggested; fallback to live model if cache miss
Quantization: test int8 and q4_0 variants; expectation: int8 reduces GPU memory and cost by ~30% with modest quality drop
Routing: keep hosted for non-PII and low-volume, Dedicated for user-data sensitive and high-throughput routes
Unit economics: compute baseline (hosted) $X/1M tokens vs dedicated amortized $Y/1M tokens depending on commit
